prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Quantum-Campus", the immaculate high-tech headquarters campus of a mega corporation in the rich upper city: a huge open plaza of polished white and pale grey stone tiles with thin glowing cyan inlay lines, crossed by perfectly geometric lawns (square and triangular patches of trimmed bright green grass with crisp white edges, flat and walkable) - this clean plaza is the large walkable area filling the middle and lower part of the image.
TOP CENTER, the whole upper middle: the base of a slender glass skyscraper (the Quantum-Spire, seen from above, only its foot and lower floors visible, glass reflecting violet light) and in front of it a glass foyer with a giant abstract round company emblem behind the glass (a symbol, no letters); in the middle of the foyer front the most eye-catching spot: a big revolving glass door with a short red carpet strip and two chrome posts in front.
TOP CENTER-LEFT at the foot of the spire: a large square ventilation grate in the plinth, slightly dark, with a few screws.
TOP CENTER-RIGHT on the foyer front: a plain narrow staff door with a small card reader that blinks red.
TOP LEFT: an elevated white pedestrian footbridge leaving the image at the top edge, reached by a wide ramp with glass railings coming down onto the plaza; next to it a slim white guard watchtower with a big searchlight on top.
LEFT SIDE, lower half: an older fenced storage yard (the "Altlager") behind a tall chain-link fence with a gate gap: two grey corrugated container halls along the left edge, a big red fire-water tank on stilts with a valve wheel, scorch marks on the concrete, some crates - shabbier and darker than the rest of the campus.
CENTER: a round modern fountain with a low white rim and glowing water.
RIGHT SIDE: a small glass break pavilion with a flat roof, a vending machine glowing inside, a few white chairs; along the right edge a tall dark green trimmed hedge in front of a white perimeter fence.
TWO slim camera masts with security cameras stand on the plaza, one left of center, one right of center.
BOTTOM CENTER: a main gate with a red-and-white barrier boom and a small white guard booth next to it.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a delivery zone with yellow-black striped markings, a drone landing ramp with charging pads and a stack of white crates, a round manhole cover with a small embossed abstract logo (no letters) in the ground.
Small things at the edges: white benches, tidy planters, low white bollards, lamp posts with cool white light, drawn small so they don't hide the floor.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP edge (north) left - the footbridge leaving the image; BOTTOM edge (south) center - the main avenue through the gate leaving the image toward a luxury boulevard; BOTTOM edge (south) right - the delivery road leaving the image.
Light and material: upper city - white stone, chrome and glass, clean cold white light, cyan inlays, the spire glowing violet; night, clear sky, crisp reflections on the polished tiles.
